tickets.title: Anthropic (Claude Haiku 5.5) as an optional Decision API provider
tickets.what: Owner 2026-11-24: one API key store ($HUD_HOME/credentials.env) serves every project; the Anthropic key and the OpenAI API key are optional model providers wherever HUD needs model judgement. HUD's Decision API has Gemini, OpenAI and TypeSafe (src/jev/decide.ts decideProviderId, docs/reference.md around 'Automatic fallback'). Add `anthropic` as a fourth provider: reads ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from credentials.env (readCredentialsEnv in src/jev/ask/config.ts, never another location), model claude-haiku-5-5, structured output through the Messages API `output_config: {format: {type: 'json_schema', ...}}` with `output_config.effort: 'low'`, called with Node's built-in fetch like the other providers (no new dependency: the SDK would vendor 29 MB / ~4,000 files into the offline release; main session 2026-11-24). Settings -> Models offers it as a primary choice; automatic fallback order becomes Gemini -> OpenAI -> Anthropic -> TypeSafe; a `stop_reason: 'refusal'` counts as a refused answer (no fallback), as other providers' refusals do. Defaults unchanged: nothing switches to Anthropic unless chosen or used as fallback. Do not log or print key values; name variables only.

acceptance.text: decideProviderId and the fallback chain accept anthropic; missing key reports ANTHROPIC_API_KEY by name
A unit test with stubbed fetch covers a valid decision, a refusal and a timeout
Settings -> Models lists Anthropic; docs/reference.md names it in the provider list and fallback order
No new dependency in package.json; the vendored lock stamp is unchanged
